title: DelayLineFrac - fractional ms delay, 3rd-order Lagrange read, >=50 ms read-distance smoothing
description:
Implement Source/DSP/DelayLineFrac only. Haas delay primitive used once per shifted channel later by ShredWidthEngine.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §§4.3 (3rd-order Lagrange), 4.4 (Haas ms delays), D9 (read-distance smoothing ≥50 ms), §7 (RT-safety), §8 (sizing)
- Any existing Source/ tree or sibling plugins' juce::dsp::DelayLine usage for style only

Implement class DelayLineFrac in Source/DSP/DelayLineFrac.h + DelayLineFrac.cpp:
1. API: prepare(const juce::dsp::ProcessSpec&” or (double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize)), reset(), setDelayMs(float ms), processSample(float x) -> float (and optionally process(float* data, int n) in-place).
2. Fractional delay: convert ms→samples at the live sampleRate; read with 3rd-order (4-point) Lagrange (§4.3 coefficients) OR juce::dsp::DelayLine<float, juce::dsp::DelayLineInterpolationTypes::Lagrange3rd> equivalent. All neighbor reads must wrap the circular storage safely.
3. Capacity: preallocate in prepare for ceil(50ms * maxSampleRate) + Lagrange guard (≥4). Never allocate/resize outside prepare. maxSampleRate may be the prepare sampleRate if host max is unknown — size at least ceil(0.05 * sampleRate) + guard; document assumption.
4. D9 smoothing: smooth the *read distance* (not the write pointer) with juce::SmoothedValue (or equivalent linear ramp) reset to ≥50 ms ramp in prepare so automation does not pitch-glitch.
5. Clamp requested delay into [minDelaySamples, maxCapacity] (min ~1 sample or 1 ms equivalent). reset() clears buffer and smoothing state.
6. RT contract: no heap, locks, logs, or vectors resize on the audio path.

Do not implement PitchShifter, crossover, width, tests, or CMakeLists (b.5 sole CMakeLists owner). Do not wire into PluginProcessor.
acceptance_criteria: DelayLineFrac exposes prepare, reset, setDelayMs, and sample/block process that return delayed audio
Delay capacity is sized in prepare for at least 50 ms at sampleRate plus Lagrange guard; no allocation outside prepare
Read path uses 3rd-order Lagrange (or juce::dsp::DelayLine Lagrange3rd equivalent)
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify PitchShifter, MonoSafetyCrossover, WidthProcessor, PluginProcessor, PluginEditor
allocate on the audio thread / outside prepare

allowed: wrap juce::dsp::DelayLine with Lagrange3rd or hand-roll circular buffer + Lagrange
implement processSample and/or block process helper
forbidden: report Haas delay as PDC / setLatencySamples
